meta_description:
17 likes, 0 comments - navyanaveli on September 28, 2026: "If tomorrow I am gone…

No more mad woman pestering you guys to study, rest, or take care of yourselves…

No more drunk laughters filling the quiet corners of the house…

No more habits that used to annoy you…

But also no more me happily carrying your emotional weight…

No more surprise visits to your room asking chking on you just like that…
No more acts of love that often go unnoticed…

REMEMBER ONE DAY, these ordinary moments may- will become memories. And regret often arrives too late.".
